arcuate-body-four-sublayer-differential: The arcuate body is built from four sublayers, and each neurotransmitter population innervates its own subset of them.
arcuate-body-layers-neurotransmitter-dis: Staining several neurotransmitters at once separates arcuate body layers that synapsin staining alone leaves indistinct.
atlas-observational-scope: Every claim here is an anatomical observation read off the atlas volumes rather than a statistical test.
cheliceral-neuropil-serotonin-tdc2-domin: Serotonin and octopamine/tyramine fibres fill the cheliceral neuropil most heavily and continue just medial to it.
gad-antibody-peripheral-penetration-only: The anti-GAD antibody stains only the outer edge of the whole-mount, so GABA patterns in the deeper neuropils cannot be trusted.
globuli-cells-cholinergic-gabaergic: The globuli cells at the mushroom body heads stain for ChAT and, more weakly, GAD, marking them as cholinergic and GABAergic.
hagstone-neuropil-serotonin-defined: Serotonin completely fills the newly named hagstone neuropil, and its staining is what marks the structure's boundaries.
leg-neuropil-serotonin-bilateral-innerva: Serotonin fibres reach each leg neuropil from the dorsal-most tract and fill it as two equal halves around a central void.
leg-neuropils-consistent-innervation: All four pairs of leg neuropils carry the same innervation pattern for every neurotransmitter mapped.
mushroom-bodies-present-asta-exclusive: Uloborus diversus, a web-building spider, has complete mushroom bodies, and only allatostatin A is found throughout them.
opisthosomal-neuropil-tdc2-perimeter-lad: Octopamine/tyramine fibres ring the edge of the opisthosomal neuropil and form a ladder of crossing projections toward its back.
pedipalpal-neuropil-chat-tdc2-dominant: Acetylcholine and octopamine/tyramine stain most strongly in the pedipalpal neuropil, and neither reaches its front portion.
protocerebral-bridge-candidate-central-c: The spider brain contains a protocerebral bridge, a candidate counterpart of the insect central complex used in path integration.
protocerebral-bridge-layered-transmitter: The protocerebral bridge is layered by transmitter, with GABA spanning it and octopamine, proctolin and acetylcholine in bands.
tonsillar-neuropil-novel-structure: A previously undescribed neuropil, named the tonsillar neuropil, stands out in the spider synganglion by its staining pattern.
tonsillar-neuropil-serotonin-core-tdc2-s: Serotonin fills the tonsillar neuropil's core, octopamine/tyramine forms a shell around it, and two peptides sit only at its rear.
uloborus-synganglion-neurotransmitter-at: A three-dimensional atlas places GABA, acetylcholine, serotonin, octopamine and several peptides in the spider's neuropils.
